pr_title: Settle a delegate orphan from its own exit log
bug_title: delegates: a settled-from-log finish does not report the delegate's worktree
defect: The PR made a resumed parent settle an orphaned delegate job from the delegate's own fiber_exited log, building the DelegateFinished in crates/jobs/src/delegate/outcome.rs and crates/loop/src/jobs.rs with `worktree: None`. The live finish reports the worktree, so on the settled path a consumer cannot tell 'not isolated' from 'isolated, unreported'.
how_identified: Issue 4313 names #4250 (the settled-from-log path) as the place the field is left None; PR 4329 resolved #4250 and its diff replaced the settled DelegateFinished literal (worktree: None) with a helper that still omits it; fix PR 4550 'Settled delegate finishes report the delegate worktree'.

pr_title: extensions: fiber.tool registers an extension's tool (#555)
bug_title: Lua extension tools: accept and pass declared hosts and hosts_surfaced
defect: The PR's `effects_from` in crates/extensions/src/lua/tool.rs refuses any key besides `effects`, `paths` and `reversible`, so a Lua tool cannot declare `hosts`, and `extension_tools.rs` builds `Effects` with `hosts: None`. Its `output_from` likewise rejects `hosts_surfaced`, although docs/tools.md already described `hosts_surfaced`.
how_identified: Blamed the pre-fix lines of PR 2745 (tool.rs effects_from, extension_tools.rs hosts: None): all from commit 8b4bdb3b (#1446); `git show 8b4bdb3b:` confirms the refusal and docs/tools.md hosts_surfaced already present.

pr_title: Let a role name the credential label its delegate runs on
bug_title: config: no notice for an ignored repository-role credential
defect: The PR added `role_credential` in crates/main/src/delegates.rs, which silently ignores a credential named by a role whose winning source is a repository, but raised no `config_key_ignored` notice. docs/configuration.md says a repository role's credential 'is ignored with a notice', so the notice is missing.
how_identified: Issue 2614 says the drop happens silently later in the delegate code; `git show 5c75e248` shows it introduced the repository-layer guard role_credential with no notice, and fix PR 2642 left that guard untouched and added the notice in the config walk.

pr_title: Name deliberately omitted models with a model_omitted notice
bug_title: model_omitted is not emitted on warm-cache startups that skip add_lua
defect: The PR made `load_candidates` in crates/extensions/src/providers.rs drain the omission marks on a cache-substituted list without emitting, leaving `add_lua` as the only emitter of `model_omitted`. A warm-cache startup that never reaches add_lua (a disabled process package, or the ModelLists::Cached readers) therefore reports no omitted model.
how_identified: Issue 4662 quotes the load_candidates comment 'each omission draws its one model_omitted notice there [add_lua]'; git blame of that comment at the pre-fix parent is cd39c3fd (#4579), and fix PR 4706 rewrote those lines.

pr_title: Share one feedback report builder between fiber feedback and /feedback
bug_title: Release: the feedback report mislabels source builds, and the installer's PATH rule for other shells
defect: The PR added `install_method` in crates/cli/src/feedback.rs, which returns 'install.sh' for any version text containing `(`. A build from a git checkout also embeds the commit in brackets, so a source build is reported as installed by install.sh, contradicting docs/user/reporting.md.
how_identified: `git log -S'fn install_method'` finds only commit 92a2f092 (#2942); fix PR 4896 changed exactly that function and its call site.

pr_title: Count models left out for a valueless placeholder in the picker
bug_title: doctor: prints one `model_unconfigured` line per model for providers never set up
defect: The PR stopped the one-notice-per-model flood for models left out by an unset host placeholder, but only in the terminal and model picker (and `fiber models`); crates/cli/src/doctor.rs still prints every `model_unconfigured` notice on its own line. A home with only a codex credential gets about 185 doctor lines for bedrock, vertex and databricks models.
how_identified: Issue 4701 says #3582 fixed the same flood for terminal and `fiber models` but not doctor; PR 3628 'Resolves #3582'. The gap is an omission in that change; fix PR 4838 groups the doctor notices.
